name: Salmon (adults)
description: Functional group pooling all five Pacific salmon species caught in PWS - Chinook, Sockeye, Coho, Pink and Chum - during their adult feeding and spawning-run phase in the Sound (June-September), because the source model measured them together (pink salmon dominate, about 83% of the catch by weight). Diet data came from pink salmon: 85% small pelagics, 15% macrozooplankton. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
